mapper.select: SELECT product_id,product_name,thumbnail_url,unit_price AS price, stock_available,stock_reserved,stock_sold FROM product_inventory WHERE merchant_id=#{merchantId} ORDER BY product_id
mapper.update: UPDATE product_inventory SET stock_available=stock_available+#{delta} WHERE product_id=#{productId} AND merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND stock_available+#{delta}>=0
mapper.select: SELECT m.id,m.order_id,m.product_id,m.movement_type,m.quantity,m.available_after, m.reserved_after,m.sold_after,m.detail,m.created_at FROM inventory_movements m JOIN product_inventory i ON i.product_id=m.product_id WHERE m.product_id=#{productId} AND i.merchant_id=#{merchantId} ORDER BY m.created_at DESC,m.id DESC LIMIT 100
